url_base.description: Base URL to prefix links starting with / in the markdown source.

flags.description: List of comma-delimited flags for translation options. Use '+' to enable, '-' to disable. e.g. '+links,+smarty'. See markdown(1) for full list.

items.description: A single flag entry, e.g. '+links' or '-smarty'.

output_style_blocks.description: If true, enables the -S option to output <style> blocks. Note: This assumes a service wrapper that maps this config to the CLI flag.
